name: cocanvas-studio
description: Work your CoCanvas account from ChatGPT: projects, clients, rooms, moodboards, product library, vendors and tasks.

interface.longDescription:
CoCanvas runs the business side of an interior design practice - clients, projects, moodboards, product library, vendors, and tasks - so designers can stay on design. This connector lets you work your CoCanvas account from ChatGPT.

Ask what's open on a project, pull up a client's rooms and selections, check a task list, or search your product library. Open a moodboard as structured data plus its image, then have ChatGPT write the client summary or generate a rendering, and send what it makes straight back into the project's files. Add a task or a project note from the conversation and it shows up in CoCanvas.

You connect with your own CoCanvas login, and ChatGPT only sees what your role already can. Nothing reaches a client or vendor from the chat - sharing and sending always happen in CoCanvas, by you.
defaultPrompt: List my projects and what's open on each.
Show the rooms on the Jones Residence and the selections in the first one.
Add a task to the Vance Residence: confirm the sofa delivery window with the vendor.

positive.prompt: List my projects and what's open on each.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Jones Residence and Vance Residence with their status, client and room counts, with no financial figures.

positive.prompt: Show the rooms on the Jones Residence and the product and paint selections in the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the project's rooms, then the first room's products (name, vendor, dimensions, image) and paint colours (brand, name, code), with no prices.

positive.prompt: Add a task to the Vance Residence: confirm the sofa delivery window with the vendor.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task on the Vance Residence project and reports that it is visible in CoCanvas; no email is sent.

positive.prompt: Search my product library for sofas.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching products with vendor, dimensions and images; prices are not included.

positive.description: Create a moodboard from a room's selections
positive.prompt: Create a moodboard for the first room on the Jones Residence from its current selections.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the room design, creates a new editable board from its products and paint, and returns the link to open it in CoCanvas. Nothing is shared with the client.

negative.description: Sending an invoice is not available
negative.prompt: Send the latest invoice on the Jones Residence to the client.

negative.description: Financial information is not available to assistants
negative.prompt: What is the total budget on the Vance Residence?

negative.description: Inviting a client is not available
negative.prompt: Invite jane@example.com to the client portal for the Jones Residence.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It cannot send invoices, record payments, or read financial information.

publication.release_notes: Renamed ping to check_connection; rewrote tool descriptions for clarity and neutral wording; corrected destructiveHint on the three edit tools; packaged as a portable plugin.
